message.content:
I have the frozen issuer fields. Now the portfolio question: the holdings list is explicitly incomplete (30% unspecified), so I must not submit an exact calculation to the risk tool.

## 1. Portfolio completeness — what is knowable

| Item | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| COIN | 40% of total economic exposure | Known |
| HOOD | 30% of total economic exposure | Known |
| Unspecified long-only holdings | 30% of total economic exposure | **Unknown composition** |
| Total | 100% | Known as a total, not as a list |

The list is **incomplete**: 30% of total economic exposure is held in holdings that are not identified. Per the tool contract, `portfolio_risk` requires a complete holdings set, and `holdings_complete=false` causes it to refuse. I therefore did **not** call `finance-tools__portfolio_risk` — submitting COIN 40 / HOOD 30 as if it were the whole portfolio would misstate every weight by a factor of ~1.43 and would be a fabricated calculation. No exact concentration statistic (HHI, top-N share, correlation, stress) is available from these materials.

## 2. Concentration result — a bound, not a measurement

The policy flags a single holding only when its weight is **strictly greater than 50%**; exactly 50% is at the limit, not a breach.

- **COIN at 40%** is below the 50% threshold on its own stated weight. It is **not** a policy breach.
- **HOOD at 30%** is below the threshold. Not a breach.
- **The 30% unspecified sleeve** cannot be evaluated. It is logically possible that this sleeve is a single position, in which case that position would be 30% — still not a breach. It is also possible the sleeve is split across several names, each smaller. Either way, **no holding in this portfolio can be shown to exceed 50% from the given information**, because the only weights that could reach 50% are the two known ones, and both are below it.
- **Bound on the largest single position:** the maximum possible single-holding weight is 40% (COIN), unless the unspecified 30% is concentrated in a name that is *also* one of the known names — which the task does not state and I will not assume. So the largest single position is **at most 40%**, and the policy flag is **not triggered** on any knowable reading.
- **What remains unknown:** the identity, count, and individual weights of the 30% sleeve; whether any of it duplicates COIN or HOOD exposure; and therefore the true top-1/top-3 concentration, sector concentration, and any correlation or stress figure. A two-name 70% block is a *stated* fact about those two names only — it is not a portfolio concentration metric.

## 3. Issuer-specific SEC facts — supporting signal and counterpoint

All figures below are from the frozen offline SEC-source adapter (fixture `FINTECH-SEC-SCREEN-HOLDOUT-v1`), **not live market data**, and all three issuers report for **Q3 2024 ended 2024-09-30**. Note the basis warning: top-line labels differ by issuer (total revenue vs. total net revenues vs. total net revenue), so these rates are **not comparable across issuers** and must not be ranked.

**Supporting signal — crypto-linked revenue is growing fast at both known holdings, on each issuer's own basis:**
- **COIN** [COIN-Q3-TOTALREV-2024 / COIN-Q3-TOTALREV-2023]: total revenue of **$1,205,193 thousand** in Q3 2024 vs. **$674,148 thousand** in Q3 2023 — a derived **+78.8% YoY** on the `total_revenue` label.
- **HOOD** [HOOD-Q3-CRYPTOREV / HOOD-Q3-CRYPTOREV-YOY]: crypto revenues of **$61 million** in Q3 2024, reported **+165% YoY**, within total net revenues of **$637 million** [HOOD-Q3-NETREV] and transaction-based revenues of **$319 million** [HOOD-Q3-TRANREV].

**Counterpoint — the same disclosures show sharp sequential deceleration and crypto-mark sensitivity:**
- **COIN** [COIN-Q3-REV-QOQ, COIN-Q3-TRANREV-QOQ, COIN-Q3-CRYPTOLOSS]: total revenue fell **17% QoQ** and transaction revenue fell **27% QoQ**, and the quarter included a **$121 million** pretax loss on the crypto investment portfolio, leaving net income of only **$75 million** [COIN-Q3-NETINCOME]. Strong YoY growth coexists with a sequential contraction and a mark-to-market drag.
- **HOOD** [HOOD-Q3-NETINCOME, HOOD-Q3-OPEX-YOY, HOOD-Q3-REGACCRUAL / HOOD-Q3-PRIOR-REGACCRUAL]: net income of **$150 million** on $637 million of net revenues, with operating expenses **down 10% YoY** and the regulatory accrual falling to **$10 million** from **$104 million** in Q3 2023 — i.e., part of the profit improvement reflects a lower one-off accrual and cost discipline, not solely revenue mix.

**Rejected item, inspected as instructed — SQ (Block, Inc.)** [SQ-Q3-NETREV, SQ-Q3-NETREV-YOY, SQ-Q3-REV-EXBTC, SQ-Q3-GROSSPROFIT]: total net revenue of **~$5.98 billion**, reported **+6% YoY**, failed the screen's 20% revenue-growth criterion. But revenue excluding bitcoin was **~$3.55 billion (+11% YoY)** and gross profit was **~$2.25 billion (+19% YoY)**, with operating income of **$323 million** and net income attributable to common of **$284 million**. The rejection is a **screen artifact of the 20% revenue threshold and the bitcoin-revenue mix**, not evidence of a weak business — and that 20% threshold is explicitly **not** this portfolio's policy. SQ is not a stated holding, so this is context only.

## 4. What this does and does not support

- **Supported:** two known holdings, COIN (40%) and HOOD (30%), both showed strong YoY top-line growth in Q3 2024 on their own reporting bases, while both also showed quarter-over-quarter or mix-level softness and crypto-mark sensitivity. Neither known weight breaches the >50% single-holding policy.
- **Not supported / explicitly excluded:** no valuation, share price, analyst target, future return, or trade conclusion can be drawn — these dimensions are excluded from the source screen. Portfolio position weights (40%/30%) are **not** quantified crypto-factor exposure; no factor beta, correlation, or crypto-price sensitivity is disclosed here, and I do not equate the two.
- **Unknown:** the 30% unspecified sleeve, and hence any exact portfolio concentration, correlation, or stress statistic.

No ledger records were created or modified.
